verdict.rationale: Fivetran's official MCP server documentation shows a FIVETRAN_SCOPE setting (read-only, read/write, read/write/delete) letting users configure least-privilege access for an agent, plus general RBAC and API key controls at the platform level. However, there's no detailed documentation on fine-grained scoped API key issuance beyond this single env var, and no independent/hands-on verification of enforcement. Missing for 10: granular per-resource scoping beyond the three tiers, first-party docs on REST API key scopes/permissions, and independent confirmation the scope restriction is enforced reliably.
